description: A PHP class implementing a menu configurator for custom fields in the OrangeHRM PIM module, responsible for overriding the current screen with 'listCustomFields'.

classes.name: CustomFieldMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements MenuConfigurator to set the current screen to 'listCustomFields' within the PIM module.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'listCustomFields' using ModuleScreenHelperTrait and returns null.
